topics.title: Coursework
topics.summary: Penn State permits AI in some classes or tasks and disallows it in others. Academic integrity policies apply even to university-approved tools.
topics.scope: Penn State course and assignment instructions govern student use. ORP research duties, AI Studio data rules, accessibility review and AI-grading approval have separate audiences.

claims.text: Penn State's Academic Integrity page makes student use of content-generating AI tools course- and assignment-specific and warns that improper use can be an academic integrity violation.

evidence.quote: In some classes, students may use AI tools. In some classes, students may not use AI tools. And in some classes, students may use AI tools for some, but not all, assignments or tasks. This applies to the use of all content-generating AI tools... The improper use of these tools can be an academic integrity violation.
evidence.title: Artificial Intelligence | Academic Integrity

claims.text: Penn State says academic integrity policies apply to student use or misuse of all tools, including university-approved AI tools.

evidence.quote: For students, academic integrity policies apply to the use or misuse of all tools, including those that are: university-approved, publicly available, offered by subscription, or purchased.
evidence.title: FAQs - AI at Penn State

coursework.en: Penn State permits AI in some classes or tasks and disallows it in others. Academic integrity policies apply even to university-approved tools.
coursework.zh: Penn State 部分课程或任务允许使用 AI，另一些不允许；即使工具经大学批准，学术诚信政策仍适用。

exams.en: The retained Penn State course-specific evidence does not confirm an exam-specific permission. Check the instructions for the exam and task.
exams.zh: 保留的 Penn State 课程范围依据未确认考试专属许可；请核对具体考试及任务说明。

disclosure.en: Penn State ORP research guidance calls for recording inputs, outputs and prompts, checking generated content and transparently disclosing use in research outputs. This is research guidance, not a universal coursework format.
disclosure.zh: Penn State ORP 研究指引要求记录输入、输出和提示词，核实生成内容，并在研究成果中透明披露使用；这不是适用于所有课程作业的统一格式。

privacy_data.en: AI Studio allows Level 1–2 data and prohibits Level 3–4. Separate Penn State guidance bars Level 3–4 information in any AI tool; human-subjects research adds IRB and agreement conditions.
privacy_data.zh: AI Studio 允许输入第 1–2 级数据，禁止第 3–4 级；Penn State 另有指引禁止向任何 AI 工具输入第 3–4 级信息，人体受试者研究还须满足 IRB 与数据协议条件。

approved_tools.en: AI Studio’s stated data allowance is limited to Level 1–2 data. It does not establish that a student may use AI Studio for a particular assessment or that access is free.
approved_tools.zh: AI Studio 所列数据许可限于第 1–2 级；这不意味着学生可在某项考核中使用，也未证明访问免费。

research_publication.en: Penn State ORP assigns researchers responsibility for documenting, verifying and disclosing AI use. Identifiable or restricted human-subjects data require explicit IRB and data-agreement approval.
research_publication.zh: Penn State ORP 要求研究者负责记录、核实和披露 AI 使用；可识别身份或受限的受试者数据须有 IRB 和数据协议的明确批准。

academic_integrity.en: At Penn State, improper AI use can breach academic integrity even when the tool is university-approved. Course and task conditions still matter; no automatic penalty is inferred.
academic_integrity.zh: 在 Penn State，即便工具经大学批准，不当使用 AI 仍可能违反学术诚信要求。须核对课程和任务条件；此处不推定自动处分。

teaching_guidance.en: Penn State instructors need the specified academic leadership approval before requesting AI-assisted grading software. This is a staff procurement step, not student permission.
teaching_guidance.zh: Penn State 教师申请 AI 辅助评分软件前须取得指定学术负责人的批准；这是教职员申请程序，不是学生使用许可。

security_procurement.en: Penn State requires an accessibility review before multi-user AI use in a class, program or office. AI-grading software requests also need the specified academic leadership approval.
security_procurement.zh: Penn State 要求在课程、项目或办公室多人使用 AI 工具前开展无障碍审核；AI 辅助评分软件申请还须取得指定学术负责人的批准。

do.en: Read the relevant course and assessment instructions.
do.zh: 核对对应课程与考核说明。

do.en: Check the audience and scope of each source.
do.zh: 核对每项来源的对象与范围。

do.en: Open the original evidence and source.

dont.en: Do not treat tool access as assessment permission.
dont.zh: 不要把工具访问资格当作考核许可。

dont.en: Do not extend unit guidance to every student.
dont.zh: 不要把局部指引扩大到所有学生。

dont.en: Do not assume an old record proves the current rule.
dont.zh: 不要假设旧记录证明当前规则。
